_comment: Every column of GOLDEN_COLUMNS must appear in exactly one of enforced, known_gaps, not_comparable or unfilled. The test refuses a column nobody has decided about.
_min_covered_comment: The sheet's Hill's block was filled from a wider page selection than the two pages recorded here, so only part of it is reachable end to end.

known_gaps.weight: packaging carries content_amount/content_uom (2.8 OZ) but the export reads weight off the product variant, so it comes out empty
known_gaps.package_configuration: purchase_uom and sellable_unit_uom are null on every Hill's row, so the export falls back to the variant UOM
known_gaps.order_multiple: order_increment has the right amount (24) but a generic UNIT — the contract does not map the printed pack unit
known_gaps.catalogue_price_basis_uom: price_basis resolves to UNIT rather than the CAN/POUCH/BOX the supplier prints
known_gaps.rrp: the normalized row carries an rrp field but it does not reach the published export

not_comparable.product_name: the sheet holds a human shorthand ('Hills F9 i/d stew 2.9oz'); the export holds the supplier's printed description
not_comparable.product name [Rosetta]: a hand-authored retail name, not something the pipeline derives
not_comparable.brand: the sheet leaves it blank for Hill's own products
not_comparable.mbb_tier_1: the sheet records the supplier's written order-value discount policy; the pipeline captures the printed per-unit price tiers
